author: Claude (AI assistant) - reference A, AI-written; must be paired with an independent reference B by a team member
note: Written from the repository's ADRs (decisions/) and source at the commit above, without any ArchTime output for this repository (it has not been mined). integration/, playground/, build and doc scripts, config files and createRoutesStub are deliberately left unassigned: the ADRs do not treat them as part of the architecture. Five test files named vite/*-test.ts fall under the 'packages/react-router-dev/vite/' prefix and are counted in that component. Coverage at the commit: 208 of 542 analysed files (npm run reference-check).
sources: decisions/0007-remix-on-react-router-6-4-0.md (server data loading, server rendering, client hydration, client data loading)
packages/*/package.json and entry files (index.ts, dom-export.ts, index-react-server*.ts)

components.name: Router core
components.responsibility: Framework-agnostic data router: history, route matching, navigations, fetchers, loaders/actions orchestration, revalidation, middleware and instrumentation; no React dependency.
evidence: ADR 0005 'Move the bulk of logic to a framework-agnostic router' and 'Inline the history library'
ADR 0015 instrumentation of navigations and fetchers (lib/router/instrumentation.ts)

components.name: React bindings
components.responsibility: The React API over the router: router components, hooks, contexts, <Link>/<Form> and browser routers, <Await>, href(); the package's public entry points.
evidence: package entry index.ts / dom-export.ts re-export these modules

components.name: Framework rendering and hydration
components.responsibility: Framework-mode client and server rendering: server entry rendering, static router, hydration, route modules, single-fetch on the client, links/meta, error boundaries, lazy route discovery (fog of war).
evidence: ADR 0007 points 2-4: server react component rendering, client hydration, client data loading

components.name: Server runtime
components.responsibility: Request handling on the server: building the request handler from the server build, document/data/resource requests, single-fetch responses, sessions and cookies, headers, CSRF checks on actions.
evidence: ADR 0007 point 1 'SSR data loading' (handleDocumentRequest, handleDataRequest, handleResourceRequest)
lib/actions.ts exports throwIfPotentialCSRFAttack, used when handling action requests

components.name: Data serialization (turbo-stream, vendored)
components.responsibility: Streaming serialization of loader/action data between server and client for single fetch.
evidence: ADR 0004 streaming APIs; vendored dependency used by single-fetch on both sides

components.name: React Server Components
components.responsibility: RSC mode: RSC server and SSR handlers, browser RSC router, HTML streaming, RSC route modules and error digests; the react-server entry points.
evidence: package.json 'react-server' export conditions point to index-react-server*.ts
lib/errors.ts encodes redirect / route error digests used by lib/rsc

components.name: Route module types
components.responsibility: Types of route modules, params, loader/action data, future flags and the register mechanism that typegen fills in.
evidence: ADR 0012 'Type inference within a route' and 'from the route config' (lib/types/register.ts, route-module.ts)

components.name: Route configuration
components.responsibility: routes.ts route config API, file-system routes convention, and the adapter for Remix's routes option.

components.name: Type generation
components.responsibility: Generates route types from the route config into .react-router/types (typegen watch / CLI command).
evidence: ADR 0012 decision: generate types from routes.ts

components.name: Vite plugin and build
components.responsibility: The framework's Vite plugin: dev server, builds, client/server code splitting, route chunks, prerendering, RSC plugin, manifest, server build and its Node adapter for dev.
evidence: ADR 0010 'Splitting up client and server code in Vite'
ADR 0009 do not rely on treeshaking (vite/remove-exports.ts, route-chunks.ts)

components.name: Config, CLI and default entries
components.responsibility: react-router.config.ts resolution, the react-router CLI (dev, build, typegen, reveal), and the default entry.client / entry.server files.

components.name: Server adapters
components.responsibility: Deploy targets around the server runtime: Node (streams, file sessions), Express, Architect (AWS), Cloudflare Workers, and the ready-made react-router-serve server.
evidence: one package per runtime; each wraps createRequestHandler from the server runtime

components.name: Project scaffolding
components.responsibility: create-react-router: interactive CLI that creates a new project from a template.
